features: Video input: H.265 / H.264, up to 8 cameras, max. frame rate 240fps
Recording up to 8MP resolution; max. network throughput 64Mbps
Datasheet lists both 'Concurrent 4K HD video recording for all channels' (4K at 30 fps for all cameras) and '8-Channel simultaneous recording up to 1080p 30fps'
8 x 100Mbps PoE ports, max. 7W per port
Max. consumption 6W stated as without camera
2 x USB 2.0 (one for the included mouse, one for video export); external USB up to 128GB
Audio input: 8 channel, G.711 u-law 8K & AAC; RCA audio output
Network protocols: IPv4, UDP, TCP, ONVIF v2.2, DHCP, NTP, DDNS, SMTP, FTP, SNMP v2, HTTP, UPnP, RTSP, RTP, RTCP
Easy Cloud P2P QR code installation; free Sentinel iOS/Android app with push notifications
Camera management per camera: OSD, image settings, PTZ, motion detection, privacy masks, video loss
Listed in TRENDnet's NDAA compliance statement (NVRs: TV-NVR1508)
